# Code Review Standards Full Guide

Use this guide for severity-first, behavior-focused PR review.

## Scope

- Correctness and regression risk
- Security and data boundary checks
- Test adequacy and confidence
- Merge readiness criteria

## Core Playbook

1. Review behavior changes first.
2. Record findings by severity with evidence.
3. Validate tests and risk controls.
4. Produce clear approve/block decision.
